a: अधिः — [आधीयते दुःखमनेन आधा कि वा पृ. थस्वः] 1 Mental pain or agony. See आधिः --2 A woman in her courses. (= अवि.) --ind. 1 (As a prefix to verbs) over, above; (अधिकार); ˚स्था to stand over; ˚कृ to place over or at the head of; ˚रुह् to grow over or above; over and above, besides, in addition (आधिक्य); fully, completely (अतिशय, विशेष), to get something in addition to another; अधिगत्यजगत्यधीश्वरात् having obtained fully, अधि intensifying the meaning of the root; इतो वा सातिमीमहे दिवो वा पार्थिवादधि Rv. 1. 6. 10; (अधीमहे आधिक्येन याचामहे). --2 (As a separable adverb) Over, above, from above (mostly Vedic); षष्टिर्वीरासो अधि षट् Rv. 7. 18. 14. --3 (As a preposition) with acc. (a) Above, over, upon, in (उपरि); यं दंतमधिजायते नाडी तं दंतमुद्धरेत् Suśr. अध्यधि just above; लोकानुपर्युपर्यास्तेऽधोऽधोऽध्यधि च माधवः Bopadeva; with gen. also; ये नाकस्याधि रोचने दिवि Rv. 1. 19. 6 above the sun; ˚विटपि Śi. 7. 35; ˚त्वत् 7. 41; ˚रजनि 52 at night. (b) With reference to, concerning, in the case of, on the subject of (अधिकृत्य) (mostly in adverbial compounds in this sense); हरौ इति अधिहरि; so अधिस्त्रि; कृष्णमधिकृत्य प्रवृत्ता कथा अधिकृष्णं; so ˚ज्योतिषं, ˚लोकं, ˚दैवं, ˚दैवतं treating of stars &c.; ˚पुरंध्रि Śi. 6. 32 in the case of women. (c) (With abl.) Just over, more than (अधिक); सत्त्वादधि महानात्मा Kaṭh.; अविदितादधि Ken. (d) (With loc.) Over, on or upon, above (showing lordship or sovereignty over something) (ऐश्वर्य); अधिरीश्वरे P. I. 4. 97; अधि भुवि रामः P. II. 3. 9 Sk. Rāma rules over the earth; the country ruled over may be used with loc. of ‘ruler’; अधि रामे भूः ibid.; प्रहारवर्मण्यधि विदेहा जाताः Dk. 77 subject to, under the government of, become the property or possession of (अधि denoting स्वत्व in this case); under, inferior to (हीन); अधि हरौ सुराः (Bopadeva) the gods are under Hari. --4 (As first member of Tatpuruṣa compounds) (a) Cheif, supreme, principal, presiding; ˚देवता presiding deity; ˚राजः supreme or sovereign ruler; ˚पतिः supreme lord &c. (b) Redundant, superfluous (growing over another); ˚दंतः = अध्यारूढः (दंतस्योपरि जातः) दंतः P. VI. 2. 188. (c) Over, excessive; ˚अधिक्षेपः high censure. According to G. M. अधि has these senses: अधिरध्ययनैश्वर्यवशित्वस्मरणाधिके . e. g.; उपाध्यायादधीते; इङोऽध्ययनार्थकत्वस्य अधिद्योतकः; अधिपतिः ( ऐश्वर्ये); अधीनः (वशित्वे) अधिगतः इनं; मातुरध्येति (स्मरणे); अधिकं (अधिके). In the Veda अधि is supposed by B. and R. to have the senses of ‘out of’, ‘from,’ ‘of,’ ‘among,’ ‘before’, ‘beforehand’, ‘for’, ‘in favour of’, ‘in’ ‘at’.

The eleven organs of sense are said to have each a presiding deity: श्रोत्रस्य दिक्, त्वचो वातः, नेत्रस्य अर्कः, रसनाया वरुणः, घ्राणस्य अश्विनौ, वागिंद्रियस्य वह्निः, हस्तस्य इंद्रः, पादस्य उपेंद्रः, पायोः मित्रः, उपस्थस्य प्रजापतिः, मनसः चंद्रश्च. --2 [अधिकृतो देवो येन गुणातिशयात्] The supreme or highest god, Almighty.

vAyumantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yo divi tizWandivo'ntaro, yaM dyOrna veda, yasya dyOH SarIraM, yo divamantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । ya Aditye tizWannAdityAdantaro, yamAdityo na veda, yasyAdityaH SarIraM, ya Adityamantaro, yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yo dikzu tizWandigByo'ntaro yaM diSo na viduryasya diSaH SarIraM, yo diSo'ntaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yaScandratArake tizWaMScandratArakAdantaro, yaYcandratArakaM na veda, yasya candratArakaM SarIraM, yaScandratArakamantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । ya AkASe tizWannAkASAdantaro, yamAkASo na veda, yasyAkASaH SarIraM, ya AkASamantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yastamasi tizWaMstamaso'ntaro, yaM tamo na veda, yasya tamaHSarIraM, yastamo'ntaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yastejasi tizWaMstejaso'ntaro, yaM tejo na veda, yasya tejaH SarIraM, yastejo'ntaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamfta ityaDidEvatam । aTADiBUtam yaH sarvvezu BUtezu tizWansarvveByo BUteByo'ntaro, yaM sarvvARi BUtAni na viduryasya sarvvARi BUtAni SarIraM, yaH sarvvARi BUtAnyantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamfta ityaDiBUtam । aTADyAtmam yaH prARe tizWanprARAdantaro, yaM, prARo na veda, yasya prARaH SarIraM, yaH prARamantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmantaryyAmyamftaH । yo vAci tizWanvAco'ntaro, yaM vANna veda, yasya vAk SarIraM, yo vAcamantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yaScakzuzi tizWaMScakzuzo'ntaro, yaM cakzurna veda, yasya cakzuHSarIraM, yaScakzurantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yaH Srotre tizWaYCrotrAdantaro, yaM SrotraM na veda, yasya SrotraM SarIraM, yaHSrotramantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yo manasi tizWanmanaso'ntaro, yaM mano na veda, yasya manaH SarIraM yo mano'ntaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yastvaci tizWaMstvaco'ntaro, yaM tvaNna veda, yasya tvak SarIraM, yastvacamantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yo vijYAne tizWanvijYAnAdantaro, yaM vijYAnaM na veda, yasya vijYAnaM SarIraM, yo vijYAnamantaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamftaH । yo retasi nizWanretaso'ntaro, yaM reto na veda, yasya retaH SarIraM, yo reto'ntaro yamayatyeza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamfto'dfzwo drazwA,'SrutaH SrotA, 'mato mantA, 'vijYAto vijYAtA, nAnyo'to'sti drazwA, nAnyato'sti SrotA, nAnyato'sti mantA, nAnyato'sti vijYAtEza ta AtmAntaryyAmyamfto'to'nyadArttam” iti । tasyEvAMSaviSezeRAvirBUtAnAM digAdyaBimAnidevAnAmindriyADizWAtftvaM yaTA “vEkArikAdahaNkArAddevA vEkArikA daSa । digvAtArkapraceto'SvivahnIndropendramitrakA” iti SAra॰ । “SaktisAmarTyAdvikftaparameSvarAdutpannatvenA'haNkArasya tadutpannadevAnAYca vEkArikatvamiti” rAGavaBawwena vyAKyAtam । “vEkArikA digAdyASca candreREkAdaSa smftAH । indriyARAmaDizWAtfdevAste parikIrttitA” iti tadDftABiyuktoktiH । taTA ca Srotrasya dik, tvaco vAtaH, netrasya arkaH, rasanAyAH varuRaH, GrARasya aSvinO, vAgindriyasya vahniH, hastasya indraH, pAdasya upendraH, pAyoH mitraH, upasTasya (kaH) prajApatiH, manasaH candraH, ityete ekAdaSendriyARAmaDizWAtfdevAH । “ISvaraM BAskare vidyAdumAM vidyAnniSAkare । skandamaNgArake vidyAdbuDe nArAyaRaM viduH । gurO vedaniDiM vidyAt Sukre Sakro viDIyate । SanEScare yamaM vidyAdrAhoH kAlaM taTEva ca । citragupto'DipaH ketorityete grahadevatAH” iti (matsyapurA॰) uktA grahARAmaDidevAH । etezAM punaraDizWAtfdevASca pratyaDidevatAtvena vyavahriyante te ca pratyaDidevatASabde darSayizyante । aDidevatApyatrEva । “AdityABimuKAH sarve sADipratyaDidevatA” iti matsyapu॰ । “SaSANkamUrtteraDidevatAkftiriti” BawwiH । candrADidevatA umA ।

m: अधि-√ दिश् (aor. Subj. Ā. 3. sg. -दिदिष्ट) to bestow, RV. x, 93, 15.
अधि-दिन n. an intercalated day.
अधि-√ 2. द्रु to cover (said of a bull), ŚBr. : Caus. -द्रावयति, to cause to cover, ŚBr.
अधि-द्यो f. (nom. औस्) a kind of brick, MaitrS.

अधि-√ 1. गा P. to obtain; P. (aor. Subj. 2. pl. -गात, or -गातन) to remember, notice, RV. & AV.; P. or generally Ā. (-जगे, -अगीष्ट, -अगीष्यत, Pāṇ.) to go over, learn, read, study; to attempt, resolve: Caus. P. -गापयति, to cause to go over or teach: Desid. Caus. -जिगापयिषति, to be desirous of teaching, Pāṇ. ii, 4, 51.

a: अधिगंतृ — a. [गम्-तृच्] One who attains or acquires.

m: अधि-√ गण् to enumerate, to value highly, BhP.

अधि-√ गम् to go up to, approach, overtake; to approach for sexual intercourse; to fall in with; to meet, find, discover, obtain; to accomplish; to study, read: Desid. P. अधि-जिगमिषति, to seek; Ā. अधि-जिगांसते, to be desirous of studying or reading.
a: अधिगम् — {c1c} P. 1 (a) To acquire, obtain, get, attain, secure; आज्ञाकरत्वमधिगम्य V. 3. 19; अधिगच्छति महिमानं चंद्रोपि निशापरिगृहीतः M. 1. 13; भर्तारमधिगच्छेत् Ms. 9. 91 marry; श्रेयांसि सर्वाण्यधिजग्मुषस्ते R. 5. 34. (b) To find, meet with, fall in with, see, discover. (c) To accomplish; अर्थं सप्रतिबंधं प्रभुरधिगंतुं सहायवानेव M. 1. 9; न मे बुद्धिर्निश्चयमधिगच्छति Mu. 5 is not able to decide; for (a) see also Ms. 2. 218, Bg. 2. 64, R. 2. 66. --2 To approach, reach, go towards or near; गुणालयोप्यसन्मंत्री नृपतिर्नाधिगम्यते Pt. 1. 384; तस्यांतं नाधिगच्छति does not reach or go to the end. --3 To study, learn; know; तेभ्योऽधिगंतुं निगमांतविद्यां U. 2. 3; श्रुतमप्यधिगम्य Ki. 2. 41; 6. 38; Ms. 7. 39; 12. 109; Y. 1. 99, Bk. 7. 37. --4 To cohabit with.

v: pu॰ aDi + gama--GaY । jYAne, prAptO, svIkAre ca । “aDyAtmayogADigameneti” gItA । niDyAdeH prAptO ca । “svAmI fkTakrayasaMviBAgaparigrahADigamezviti” gOta॰ । “aDigamo niDyAdeH prAptiriti” mitA॰ ।
m: अधि-गम m. the act of attaining, acquisition
acquirement, mastery, study, knowledge
mercantile return, profit, &c.
a: अधिगमः --मनं — 1 Acquisition, obtaining, getting, finding &c.; दुरधिगमः परभागः Pt. 5. 34; वंशस्थितेरधिगमात् V. 5. 15; दाराधिगमनं Ms. 1. 112 marriage. --2 Mastery, study, knowledge; असच्छास्त्राधिगमनं Ms. 11. 66. --3 Mercantile return, profit; acquiring property; निध्यादेः प्राप्तिः Mit. or धनप्राप्तिः; स्थापयंति तु यां वृद्धिं सा तत्राधिगमं प्रति Ms. 8. 157. --4 Acceptance. --5 Intercourse.

m: अधि-गमनीय or अधि-गम्य, mfn. attainable practicable to be learnt.
अधि-गमन n. acquisition
finding
acquirement, reading, study
marriage, copulation.

a: अधिगम्य, --गमनीय, --गंतव्य — pot. p. Attainable &c.

m: अधि-गन्तव्य mfn. attainable, to be studied.
अधि-गन्तृ m. one who attains or acquires.
अधि-गर्त्य (5) mfn. being on the driver's seat, RV. v, 62, 7.

m: अधि-गत mfn. found, obtained, acquired
gone over, studied, learnt.
a: अधिगत — p. p. 1 Acquired, obtained &c; ˚परमार्थान्पंडितान्मावमंस्थाः Bh. 2. 17. --2 Studied, known, learnt, mastered; किमित्येवं पृच्छस्यनधिगतरामायण इव U. 6. 30.

v: avya॰ gavi viBaktyarTe avyayI॰ vede ac samA॰ । gavItyarTe “svAdIyo yadaDigavaM kzIramiti” vedaH ।
m: अधि-गव mfn. being on or in a cow, derived from a cow, AV. ix, 6, 39.
a: अधिगव — a. or adv. [गवि इत्यधिगवं अव्ययी-स.] Found in or derived from a cow; स्वादीयो यदधिगवं क्षीरं.

m: अधि-गृहम् ind. in the house, in the houses, Śiś. iii, 45.
अधिगोपम् ind. on a cowherd, Laghuk. 970.
अधिगोप्तृ see धनाध्˚.
अधि-ग्रीवम् ind. upon the neck, up to the neck.

m: अधि-गुण mfn. possessing superior qualities, Megh.
a: अधिगुण — a. [अधिका गुणा यस्य] 1 Possessing superior qualities, worthy, meritorious; याच्ञा मोघा वरमधिगुणे नाधमे लब्धकामा Me. 6. --2 [अधिगतो गुणो ज्या येन] well strung (as a bow); ˚शरासनं जनाः Ki. 12. 14. --णः A superior or eminent merit.

अधि-हरि ind. concerning Hari, Pāṇ. ii, 1, 6, Sch.
अधि-हस्ति ind. on an elephant, Ragh.
अधि-हस्त्य n. a present &c. held in the hand, Āpast.
अधि-√ हृ to procure, furnish.
अधि-√ हु (impf. 3. pl. -अजुह्वत) to make an oblation upon or over, RV. i, 51, 5.
अधि-√ जागृ (only -जागरत्), to watch over (loc.), Hir.
अधि-जानु ind. on the knees, Śiś.
अधि-ज mfn. born, superior by birth, Pāṇ. iii, 2, 101, Sch.
अधि-जङ्घम् ind. on the legs, Naiṣ.
अधि-√ जन् to be born.
अधि-जनन n. birth, Mn. ii, 169.
a: अधिजननं — Birth; मातुरग्रेऽधिजननं Ms. 2. 169.

m: अधि-जरायु f. (a cow) having the after-birth in itself or part of it, AV.Paipp.
अधि-√ जि (Subj. 2. sg. -जयासि) to win in addition, RV. vi, 35, 2. (Prec. 1. pl. -जीयास्म), to overcome, Bhaṭṭ.
अधि-जिगांसु mfn. (fr. Desid. of अधि-√ गम्) wishing to learn, HPariś.

m: अधि-जिह्व, अस्, m. or अधि-जिह्विका, f. a peculiar swelling of the tongue or epiglottis, Suśr.
a: अधिजिह्वः — [अधिका जिह्वा यस्य] A serpent (who has a forked tongue). This arose from the attempt of the serpents to lick the nectar placed on a bed of Kuśa grass, the sharp points of which pricked the tongue and split it into two. --ह्वा --जिह्विका [अधिरूढा जिह्वा, स्वार्थे कन्] 1 The uvula. --2 A sort of swelling of the tongue or epiglottis.

m: अधि-ज्य mfn. having the bowstring (ज्या) up or stretched, strung, ŚBr. &c.
a: अधिज्य — a. [अध्यारूढा ज्या यत्र, अधिगतं ज्यां वा] Having the bow-string stretched, well strung (as a bow). --Comp. --धन्वन्, --कार्मुक a. having the bow strung; त्वयि चाधिज्यकार्मुके Ś. 1. 6.
अधिज्यता — The state of being strung; ˚तां नी to string; R. 11. 14.

a: अधिकरणं — [कृ-ल्युट्] 1 Placing at the head of, appointing &c. --2 Relation, reference, connection; रामाधिकरणाः कथाः Rām. referring to. --3 (In gram.) Agreement, concord, government or grammatical relation (as of subject and predicate &c.); तत्पुरुषः समानाधिकरणः कर्मधारयः P. I. 2. 42 having the members (of the compound) in the same relation or apposition; समानाधिकरणो or व्यधिकरणो बहुव्रीहिः; पीतांबरः, चक्रपाणिः &c. --4 A receptacle or subject, technically substratum; ज्ञानाधिकरणं आत्मा T. S. the soul is the substratum of knowledge. --5 Location, place, the sense of the locative case; आधारोधिकरणं P. I. 4. 45; कर्तृकर्मव्यवहितामसाक्षाद्धारयत् कियाम् . उपकुर्वत् क्रियासिद्धौ शास्त्रेधिकरणं स्मृतम् .. Hariv.; as गेहे स्थाल्यामन्नं पचति. --6 A topic, subject; section, article or paragraph; a complete argument treating of one subject; the Sūtras of Vyāsa and Jaimini are divided into Adhyāyas, the Adhyāyas into Pādas and the Pādas into Adhikaraṇas or sections. According to the Mīmāṃsakas a complete Adhikaraṇa consists of five members: --विषय the subject or matter to be explained, विशय or संशय the doubt or question arising upon that matter, पूर्वपक्ष the first side or prima facie argument concerning it, उत्तर or उत्तरपक्ष or सिद्धांत the answer or demonstrated conclusion, and संगति pertinency or relevancy, or (according to others निर्णय the final conclusion); विषयो विशयश्चैव पूर्वपक्षस्तथोत्तरं . निर्णयश्चेति सिद्धांतः शास्त्रेऽ धिकरणं स्मृतम् .. The Vedāntins put संगति in the 3rd place, and सिद्धांत last; तत्र एकैकमधिकरणं पंचावयवं, विषयः संदेहः संगतिः पूर्वपक्षः सिद्धांतश्च. Generally speaking, the five members may be taken to be विषय, संशय, पूर्वपक्ष, उत्तरपक्ष and सिद्धांत or राद्धांत. --7 Court of justice, court, tribunal; स्वान्दोषान् कथयंति नाधिकरणे Mk. 9. 3; ˚रणे च साधनं Dk. 40. --8 Stuff, material; विप्रतिषिद्धं चानधिकरणवाचि P. a: अधिरुह् — {c1c} P. 1 To ascend, mount (a throne, hill &c.); go up to, find access to, sit in or on (acc.); पादाहतंयदुत्थाय मूर्द्धानमधिरोहति Śi. 2. 46; पुराधिरूढः शयनं महाधनं Ki. 1. 38. lying on; तुरगाधिरूढं R. 7. 37 riding a horse; 12. 104; बंधुजनाधिरूढैर्गजानां वृंदैः Ku. 7. 52 mounted or seated on; योगाधिरूढाः R. 13. 52; engaged or lost in contemplation; so Pt. 1; सद्यः परस्परतुलामधिरोहतां द्वे R. 5. 68 bear or acquire; प्रतिज्ञां˚ enter on; कीर्तिर्द्यामधिरोहति Śi. 2. 52.; सर्वमनोरथानामग्रमिवाधिरूढा K. 158 mounted on the summit or pinnacle; त्वां धूरियं योग्यतयाधिरूढा Ki. 3. 50 this responsibility lies on your shoulders. --2 To string; अधिरोहति गांडीवं महेषौ Ki. 13. 16. --3 (Intran.) To rise or grow over or above. --Caus. [रोह -(प) यति] 1 To raise, place, seat, cause to mount or ascend; ताः स्वमंकमधिरोप्य R. 19. 44 having placed or seated; Śi. 12. 46. --2 To restore, give back; पुराणशोभामधिरोपितायां (वसतौ) R. 16. 42 restored to its former grandeur. --3 To string (as a bow); कार्मुकं च बलिनाधिरोपितम् R. 11. 81. --4 To give, confer &c.; उदारक इति प्रीतलोकाधिरोपितापरश्लाध्यनामनि Dk. 50.
